papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.summary: Fine-tuning large MoE models on a low-resource language shifts reasoning into that language without harming accuracy, while RL with verifiable rewards fixes formatting and leakage defects.

papers.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
papers.summary: A capability-driven data infrastructure with curriculum scheduling and specialized data engines trains large multimodal diffusion models on curated heterogeneous supervision for diverse generative tasks.

papers.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
papers.summary: EditBridge enables efficient ultra high-resolution image editing via a diffusion bridge that translates low-resolution edits to high-resolution outputs while preserving source details through sparse attention.

papers.title: Deep Academic Survey: Stateful Agentic Closed-Loop Paradigm for Academic Survey Automation
papers.summary: DAS is a stateful agentic framework that separates reusable paper analysis from survey construction to generate validated, citation-grounded academic surveys with structured planning and repair loops.

papers.title: GS-Voxel: Fitting-Free Structured Latents for Large-Scale 3DGS Generation
papers.summary: GS-Voxel converts unstructured 3D Gaussian reconstructions into sparse structured latents to enable scalable aerial scene generation via flow models.

papers.title: aDSL: Agentic 3D Creation via Joint Agent-Program Design
papers.summary: Jointly designs an Agent-centric Domain-Specific Language (aDSL) and multi-agent system for 3D content creation, bridging semantic logic and geometric constraints.
